The two substantival articles are treated differently for the reason rule 31 states: τοῖς κατὰ τὸν νόμον has a verbless modifier, so the article keeps *things which* and κατά carries the supplied copula, while τοῖς … γεγραμμένοις has a participle to carry the verb, so rule 90 leaves the article only *which*.
